findings.coco_author: all 220 COCO authors are generated labels 'flickr_contributor_<coco_id>', not verified creators
findings.coco_published_date: field holds COCO date_captured, not a publication date
findings.coco_origin_url: points to the COCO-hosted copy, not the Flickr photo page; no Flickr photo ID recorded
findings.coco_nd: 91 entries are BY-ND or BY-NC-ND: no sharing of edited derivatives without separate permission
findings.unsplash_channel: Unsplash Lite dataset (HF mirror): dataset terms grant download/store and internal ML training only and prohibit disseminating/redistributing the data; editing and sharing the cohort is not covered. The generic Unsplash License was assumed without checking the dataset terms.
findings.unsplash_rendition: download_url requests a processed rendition (auto=format, fit=crop, w=600, q=80): resized, re-compressed, format negotiated; not the original upload
findings.historical_disjointness: v1 compared zero-padded COCO IDs to Option P source IDs (same COCO namespace); Unsplash IDs were compared to COCO IDs, which proves nothing
